dedupe_keys.name: liveline multistage continuous flow manufacturing run

description: Liveline Technologies shares a production run from a continuous manufacturing line near Detroit, Michigan. Three parallel machines feed a combiner, followed by two serial machines. Output properties are measured at fifteen positions after the combiner and again after the final machine. The Kaggle deposit lists a CSV file and explanatory notes; coverage spans several hours of one run. Access has no stated charge, while the registry reserves data copyright to the original authors, not stating an open licence. A limitation is that one run cannot establish variability across operating regimes or other production lines; detailed field units and sampling frequency require the linked notes. Simulation uses include fitting staged process-response models and checking predicted output properties against measurements. It complements data-nasa-prognostics-data-repository with parallel and serial production dependencies. No values, proprietary process details or real-time controller were downloaded or executed.
